Rahul Gandhi meets actor Vijay and students in Chennai

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi arrived in Chennai to meet actor Vijay at his residence. Following the meeting, Gandhi and Vijay were seen having coffee together. Gandhi also attended an event called 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' to hear from students.
